name: ai.sovantica/engrava
description: MindQL queries, hybrid search, and a thought graph — read/write embedded memory for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAVA_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file. Created if missing; its directory must exist. Enough on its own: full-text search, the graph and MindQL work, but vector search needs ENGRAVA_MCP_CONFIG.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAVA_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to an engrava.yaml, for an embedding provider (vector search) and the audit journal. When set, it takes precedence and ENGRAVA_DB_PATH is not read.

environmentVariables.name: ENGRAVA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register no write tools.
